scenes.vo: Doctors measure you in the morning for a reason.
You shrink daily, but three habits stop that.
First, stretch two minutes before standing.
Second, drink water to refill spinal discs.
Third, sleep on your back so your spine resets.
And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.
